question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it be opt-in or default-on for existing users?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and fits the plugin boundary, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index lifecycle policy, and overlaps with external plugin and memory-core reranker directions.

options.title: Add opt-in plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Implement FTS indexing and hybrid retrieval behind explicit memory-lancedb config first, preserving vector-only behavior as the upgrade-safe default until maintainers decide otherwise.

options.title: Add default-on official parity
options.body: Make hybrid retrieval the default for memory-lancedb, but require upgrade proof and fallback behavior that shows existing recall and duplicate detection do not regress unexpectedly.

options.title: Keep advanced LanceDB retrieval external
options.body: Document memory-lancedb as vector-only and route BM25/rerank-heavy LanceDB behavior to external plugins or ClawHub packages instead of expanding the official plugin.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Implement FTS indexing and hybrid retrieval behind explicit memory-lancedb config first, preserving vector-only behavior as the upgrade-safe default until maintainers decide otherwise.
